# How to Use This Book {.unnumbered}

This book is a reference, not a reading schedule for every module. The unit sets the order. The book supports the work.

The 2027 edition adds three practice chapters at the front of the build:

- Chapter 2, **Specify Before You Build**, turns a client brief into a contract with acceptance criteria.
- Chapter 3, **Checks That Run**, turns those criteria into evidence that the site still works.
- Chapter 4, **The Agent-Ready Repo and Handover**, turns the build into a repository that another person can run and maintain.

Read those three when you are building. Read the concept chapter you need when you need it.

| If you need to | Read |
|---|---|
| Understand the client and write the spec | Chapter 2, then Chapter 5 |
| Audit the site at 375px | Chapters 5 and 6 |
| Write a check and read the output | Chapter 3 |
| Integrate live data and handle failure | Chapter 8 |
| Choose a content platform | Chapters 10 and 11 |
| Extend or audit a WordPress site | Chapters 11 and 12 |
| Present data from an API | Chapters 8 and 13 |
| Build a component front end | Chapter 15 |
| Polish, hand over and defend the build | Chapters 16 and 17 |
| Evaluate a technology and recommend it | Chapters 19, 20 and 21 |

The 2027 course map appendix maps each module to the chapters that support it. When the course map and this book disagree, the course map wins.

This edition supports ISYS3004 Business Web and Mobile Technologies, S1 2027.
